name: 兩格滿版圖片並排＋左下疊字
desc: 兩張等寬的大圖片左右並排並延伸到畫面邊緣，各自在左下角疊上標題、說明文字與按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上下不留白，圖片貼齊區塊的上下緣；沒有獨立的標題組。兩個項目左右並排，等寬等高、各佔約一半寬度，外側貼齊畫面左右邊緣，不對齊頁面內容寬度。每個項目是一張接近方形的圖片，同一組圖片同一比例；文字疊在圖片左下角，靠左對齊：標題（可多行）在上，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。文字只集中在圖片下方一小部分，上方大面積只有圖片。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：兩個項目上下排列，第一個在上，每個項目橫跨畫面寬並貼齊畫面左右邊緣，圖片改為直式；文字仍疊在圖片左下角，順序不變。區塊上下仍不留白。

en.name: Two full-bleed image tiles side by side with bottom-left overlay text
en.desc: Two equal-width large images sit side by side, extending to the viewport edges, each with a title, description and button overlaid in its bottom-left corner.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section has no spacing above or below; the images are flush with the top and bottom edges of the section. There is no separate heading group. Two items sit side by side, equal in width and height, each taking about half the width, with their outer sides flush with the left and right edges of the viewport rather than aligned to the page content width. Each item is a nearly square image, and both images share the same proportion; text is overlaid in the bottom-left corner of the image, aligned left: a title (may wrap to multiple lines) on top, optionally with a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. The text occupies only a small area near the bottom of the image, leaving a large image-only area above.
en.mobile: Stack vertically: the two items are placed one above the other, the first on top, each spanning the viewport width and flush with its left and right edges, with the images becoming portrait; the text stays overlaid in the bottom-left corner of the image in the same order. The section still has no spacing above or below.
